memory.limitation: Sampled MemAvailable is host-wide. It cannot attribute memory to vLLM, the page cache, or another process, and one-second samples can miss peaks.

profile.note: Capacity/throughput variant of the production profile. Same checkpoint, image and contract; only the memory plan, sequence cap and prefill chunk change. Promote only if it passes 10/10 screens without regressions.

host.note: Before start: room for 33 GiB of weights, the KV pool and the page cache.
